Privacy Policy

Last Updated: September 2026

At BiliExtract, user privacy is fundamental to how we engineer our software. This Privacy Policy outlines what minimal information is collected, how it is handled, and your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).

1. Data We Do NOT Collect

  • We do not require user accounts, registration, or logins.
  • We do not store your downloaded files. When you process a video link, the stream is fetched dynamically into your client browser. No persistent media copies or user audio/video files remain on our server disks once the transfer is finalized.
  • We do not track your personal identity. We do not attach personal names, phone numbers, or credit card details to your activity.

2. Information Collected Automatically

Like most web utilities, our web servers automatically log basic, non-personally identifiable technical information to diagnose server load and mitigate spam/bot attacks:

  • Browser type, language, and operating system.
  • Referring URLs and general geographical location (country/city level).
  • Timestamps of requests and aggregate bandwidth utilization.
  • Anonymized IP addresses (used solely for rate-limiting to prevent server abuse).

3. Cookies and Local Storage

  • Functional Storage: We may use local browser storage (localStorage) to remember your preferred interface preferences (such as dark/light mode or default video resolution settings).
  • Analytics Cookies: We use lightweight, privacy-focused analytics to monitor daily visitor numbers and peak conversion times without cross-site tracking.

4. Third-Party Advertising & Partner Disclosures

To keep this utility 100% free, we partner with reputable third-party advertising networks (e.g., Google AdSense, ad exchange networks).

These third-party vendors may use cookies, web beacons, or unique device identifiers to serve ads based on your prior visits to this website or other sites on the internet.

Google's use of advertising cookies: Google and its partners use the DoubleClick cookie to serve personalized ads based on visits across the web. You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting the Google Ads Settings.

You can also opt out of third-party vendor cookies across multiple networks by visiting the Network Advertising Initiative Opt-Out Page or AboutAds.

5. GDPR & CCPA Compliance

If you reside within the European Economic Area (EEA) or California:

  • You have the right to request what non-personally identifiable data we maintain, request correction, or request deletion of IP server logs.
  • You may configure your browser to reject cookies or refuse tracking banners presented upon your first visit.
